searchText: QQ: whats the status of withdrawals on the CL? We have a branch that *should* ™️ implement the latest spec. Would love to start testing, setting up a testnet etc if we have CL's implementing it already We will be ready in 1-2 weeks 🫡 Detailed tracking: https://github.com/prysmaticlabs/prysm/issues/11077 https://notes.ethereum.org/@ralexstokes/SyDqVjr4i If anyone needs a method to create withdrawal credential change operations there is a branch of `ethdo` that had this (will be merged to master "soon")
